initialExam.title: RPSC RAS/RTS 2026
initialExam.description: Rajasthan Administrative Service and Rajasthan Taxation Service exam for state civil services in Rajasthan. Notification released 27 May 2026; applications open till 3 Jul 2026.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS-I (150Q), GS-II (150Q). Mains: 4 GS papers + Hindi/English + Optional. Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers, 400 marks. Mains: Multiple papers. Interview.
initialExam.jobRole: SDM, DSP, and other Rajasthan state service posts
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government bungalow, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
